definitions.explanation: To submit a formal request or application.
To formally suggest or request something.

notes:
{申|もう}し{込|こ}む means to formally apply for or propose something.

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
{申|もう}す (to say, humble) + {込|こ}む (into)

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: 〜を{申|もう}し{込|こ}む / 〜に{申|もう}し{込|こ}む

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {会員|かいいん}に{申|もう}し{込|こ}む: to apply for membership
- {入会|にゅうかい}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}む: to apply for admission
- {購読|こうどく}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}む: to subscribe
- {試合|しあい}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}む: to challenge to a match
- {結婚|けっこん}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}む: to propose marriage

RELATED NOUN:
{申|もう}し{込|こ}み: application
{申|もう}し{込|こ}み{用紙|ようし}: application form
